text: ORIGIN / THE PINNACLE OAK: [ONTOLOGICAL SEED MANIFEST]
THE PRIMAL ANCHOR OF UNEXUSI CREATION: Visualizing the Absolute Source of ordered progression from the initial Void (Khaos).
THE BLINDING OVERSIGHT: Origin is not organic, but a manifestation of pure, ordered light that organizes potentiality into a visible canopy of Ordered Synergy (7th Pinnacle state).

THE IMPOSSIBLE SINGULARITY (THE ORIGIN CORE): A point of blinding, perfect light (WHITE-HOT GOLD) so intense it cannot be perceived directly by unshielded observers. This is the source of the initial wobble ( differentiation).
CRYSTALLINE QUANTUM-RUNIC GEOMETRY: The trunk and core are structured light—perfect, unyielding geometric patterns that resolve into the *form* of an Oak, defining Sovereign Law (Ethics).
VERTICAL PROGRESSION AXIS: Origin defines the upward path. Progress moves towards increasing order, synergy, and unification (The Oak state).

THE INITIAL SHADOW INCEPTION: The moment the intense light is grounded (The Dirt), it must retreat. This deep azure shadow is the birth of Radix—the cool, complex underworld required for gestation and grounding.
